notes.title: [Update] v1.4 & Free Bird DLC
notes.notes:
Hello!


The v1.4 Update and the Free Bird DLC we introduced last week have been released today!

In addition, Steam Trading Cards and Points Shop items are now available—please check them out!


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3404470/view/501708794524336585"][/dynamiclink]

[hr][/hr]Update Summary
v1.4
8 new amusement facilities have been added for guests to enjoy.

Free Bird DLC
- A free downloadable character pack that adds 5 new bird characters.
- These new bird characters can visit as guests or be hired as staff, and 6 new letters have also been added.

Steam Trading Cards & Points Shop
- Trading cards and reward items are now available, which can be earned by playing the game.
- New Points Shop items have been added as well, which can be purchased with Steam Points to decorate your profile.
[hr][/hr]Thank you!

notes.title: 100K Downloads Update!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/fea889ffa66a39e639bcc9c8101be18c5e82f04a.png"]

Hello! ːoguHeartː

It’s hard to believe, but it’s already been almost 4 months since the release of Maltese’s Fluffy Onsen. Thanks to all of your love and support, the game has surpassed 100,000 downloads! 🎉

As a token of our appreciation to our players, we’re planning to release a free character DLC and content update next week.

In addition, Steam Trading Cards and Points Shop items will also be launching, and we’ll be holding a 20% discount to celebrate both the Publisher Sale and the upcoming Autumn Sale.



Please see the details below!
[hr][/hr]

1. Free DLC – 5 Bird Characters
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/5ea56d834a796fa4c52a4a747d72ac9008a1d171.gif"]


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3978440/Malteses_Fluffy_Onsen__Bird_DLC/"][/dynamiclink]


Chubby, feathered friends with wings are coming to the onsen!
With the newly released free Bird DLC, you can add 5 new characters to your game.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/633596135fa11514d09fd71644efd8c3e25b8784.jpg"]



Bird characters such as Chick, Sparrow, and Long-tailed Tit will visit the bathhouse just like other characters. They can also be hired as staff members or send you letters.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/f9cded19e29925bd697e459f334303fb4e743106.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/b5d6b818564ae58b48036e25b6551b637c4885f8.png"]
[hr][/hr]3. Steam Trading Cards & Points Shop Items


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/70fec4060ecbf7846c8e6d97fe1c7a0e76c4e850.png"] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/bedb929a7acfc10a274b5df87ecd5f9e3eea42da.png"]

Collect all 10 cards to upgrade your badge, and earn rewards such as Steam profile backgrounds and emoticons.

Fixed an issue where the Black Goat could be unlocked without owning the Summer DLC and would not appear in the animal encyclopedia.

Fixed an issue where bath bubbles would rise too high and be visible from other floors.

Convenience Features

notes.title: Update & Sale Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
It’s already been a month since the game launched.

Although version 1.1 brought some new characters and decorations, we know many of you were hoping for even more guests, more decor, and improvements to some of the game’s inconveniences.

To celebrate the Steam Summer Sale, we’re offering a 12% discount — and with it, our hot spring has gone through some big changes.


Check out all the details below![previewyoutube="On9dY-AJi3k;full"][/previewyoutube]New ContentNew Characters: Calico Cat, Angora Rabbit, White Goat
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/b345418523766a9e9991252a97d18d707e688c97.gif"]



Three new characters — the Calico Cat, Angora Rabbit, and White Goat — are visiting your hot spring!
Just like other special-grade guests, these animals will appear once certain conditions are met.


New SystemsDecoration Rotation
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/3935550c63a7750ff1f779c86f3e8458412012c3.png"]



You can now rotate many of the decorative objects!
To maintain data stability, this applies mainly to direction-specific items.
Click on an item and press the R key to rotate it.


Customize the Maltese
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/29825d5d056719263ef11bf21ea1e71ad8dd8191.png"]

You can now dress up our beloved hot spring owner, the Maltese!

Separate from the staff hats, the Maltese can wear both head and body outfits.
There are plenty of cute options available, such as a work uniform, casualwear, flower hat, sunglasses, and more.
If the staff hat interferes with the look, you can now disable it just for the Maltese.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/8ee5d008689f9d9511bd955680e071ae71bfba22.png"]

You can access the new Maltese Customization tab via the newly added Franchise Management Desk or by clicking on the Maltese directly.
All customization items can be purchased using points earned through this desk.


Guest Thoughts
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/7bbd285e08b9a8d33afbcda05db09e8b8a7bed85.png"]

You can now click on guests to read their thoughts!
See what they’re thinking or planning to do next.


Enhanced Stage IdentitySave Slot Points
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/5ee32e31c29bd4c0bac3c604b86aa5e8dd494561.png"]

You can now earn points from each of your save slots.
Points accumulate every minute based on how much currency that slot generates per minute, and each stage gives a different type of currency based on its theme.

These currencies can be used to purchase Maltese customization items — and we plan to expand their use even further in future updates.


Staff Dispatch System
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/3ba4f7f3a98a7f587e6794803f89b1cfce64f892.png"]

To ease the burden of starting a new save slot, we’ve added a Staff Dispatch Desk that lets you copy staff from other slots.

Dispatched staff will stay employed only for a limited time before leaving automatically.
You can upgrade the dispatch duration and max number of dispatched staff through the Staff Training Room.


51 New Letters & BGMs from Stage Residents
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/cb9b9b965c2adee2d93acb2e3ed6741990f50b4e.png"]

A total of 51 new letters from stage residents have been added, each accompanied by a unique BGM reflecting the story.

You can obtain these letters by having guests enjoy their favorite facilities.
The base stage includes 3 letters, while each of the other 8 stages includes 6.


Enjoy the View Through the Window!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/e6a376aed400bb378c17c59b0d46e2a995b96bd5.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/d55c8469c764b97e351eace46644d18db9965c4e.png"]

We’ve added new window decoration items you can place on walls.
Through them, you’ll see stage-specific backgrounds, and the scenery will change its tone depending on the time of day.

Use these windows to bring out the mood and charm of each stage!




Don’t forget — this update goes live on Friday, June 27, the start of the Steam Summer Sale!



About the Name Change
As we localize the game into more languages and expand it to a global audience, we’ve changed the original title “Animal Spa” to a more distinctive and descriptive name:
“Maltese's Fluffy Onsen”.

We sincerely apologize for any confusion caused by this change, and we’re doing our best to continue building a cozy and content-rich hot spring experience.





Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: [Patch Note] v1.11c
notes.notes:
Hello!
Before we roll out the next content update introduced in our roadmap, we’ve added a few useful features in advance. Please check out the details below.

Bilibili Viewer Participation Feature Added
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/cae93d53b43853e860f450dbd5aa2b56d0344de7.png

A viewer interaction system for the streaming platform Bilibili has been added.
You can find more details in the in-game help documentation under the UI section.


Object Floor Transfer Feature Added
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/c246afca136ae354749da96d604f2ea9604ee3d3.png

Previously, to move an object to another floor, you had to remove it and reinstall it on the desired floor.
This process has been improved—now you can move objects across floors directly by placing them or selecting an already placed object and pressing the 1~5 keys to shift floors and position them where you want.

We’re currently preparing a variety of new updates, including content we introduced in our roadmap.
Stay tuned!

notes.title: [Patch Note] v1.1e & Roadmap
notes.notes:
Hello, and thank you to everyone who has been enjoying Animal Spa!

It’s already been two weeks since the game launched.
Since the release of the v1.1 update, we’ve been collecting valuable feedback from players and are actively preparing for the next content update.

Below, we’ll first introduce patch v1.1e, which includes several bug fixes, and then share some of the content updates we’re working on for the future.

------------------------------------

Patch Notes

UI

 Fixed an issue where the Settings and Close buttons were unclickable when positioned above the entrance door.
 The manual configuration label in the Floor Planning Desk now shows text instead of a number.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where guests expressed reactions to decorations too frequently.
 Fixed an issue where decoration reactions were incorrectly displayed in the all-floor view.
 Fixed an issue where former employees, when visiting as guests, still carried bundles in their hands.


Visual Improvements

 Fixed a bug where the desktop wallpaper could be seen through the TV when moving it.
 Fixed inconsistent opacity between the Bath Goods Store and the Deluxe Private Spa time displays.


---------------------------------------
Upcoming Features in Development

Letters from Each Stage
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/6286ad430b25dd14799e993d2c0725ab0d849eda.png

While running your bathhouse, have you ever wondered who lives in those nearby houses or who runs those small shops?
In upcoming updates, you’ll start receiving letters from the residents of each stage, such as Maple Village or Winter Town.

Through these letters, you’ll get a glimpse into the everyday lives of the locals—not just your customers, but the townsfolk who make up the world around your spa!



Item Rotation
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/9297fbfd8a6428bd13719b1fb04e3e50cccbc56f.png

We’re working on adding the item rotation feature, one of the most requested functions.
To maintain stability with existing data, we’ll first apply this feature mainly to decorative items with a defined length rather than all structures.





Staff Dispatch System
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/ca189a9def0fd688684aa0b3e77faed0440f02af.png

We’re developing a staff dispatch system that allows you to temporarily bring employees from other save files.
Dispatched staff will assist for a certain period before returning. This feature aims to ease the early burden when starting a new save and strengthen the connection between slots.



Point Collection & Maltese Customization
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/149bae91ec92ea6c1830f54fbc07fa87abad49c5.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/3855d5bb65508a4daba84abc21921ba460b6cd1a.png

You’ll soon be able to collect points from all your save files.
These points can be used to purchase cosmetic items for the main character, Maltese, or to enhance save slots (feature under consideration).


Steam Points Items

We are also preparing Steam profile items (e.g., avatars, backgrounds, badges). Please look forward to them!

notes.title: [Patch Note] v1.1 Content Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
It’s already been a week since Animal Spa launched!

We’ve been carefully going through all the valuable feedback and suggestions you’ve shared with us.
Thanks to your incredible support, we even reached over 5,000 concurrent players,
and with that momentum, we’re excited to bring you the 1.1 content update.

We’ve prepared a bunch of new additions—from a new character and items,
to various helpful features that improve gameplay.
We’re also sharing a preview of upcoming systems,
so you can get a glimpse of the direction we’re headed to make Animal Spa even more fun and engaging!


New Character: Guinea Pig

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/a5900dfd67ffe9815c5c4b0766019626ded74ceb.gif

The guinea pig is now visiting the bathhouse.
As part of the "groundhog" family, just like other groundhog characters, it enjoys lukewarm baths and desserts.


New Decoration Items

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/07f2c95a4425c268324f9a9418fe2bf315465d15.png

Over 20 new decorative items and 3 new interior themes have been added.
Decoration items may continue to be added based on player requests or seasonal themes, so stay tuned.


New Feature: TV

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/ae1396f9b60ad723b3a5a2d0a7486b194876ddd9.gif

A TV item that guests can gather around and enjoy has been added.
You can set the TV channel yourself, and depending on the channel, the chance of receiving stars from certain types of guests will vary.


New Feature: Decoration Reactions

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/2fa295fa72fa7a3771036e037f7a2641d0bfdc1f.png

Guests will now react to decorations placed in the bathhouse.
You can check their thoughts and earn stars based on their reactions.


New Feature: Object Interaction Animations

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/b22bd9118d575174818c80958669b15f7a303388.gif {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/5ee84f4930fa40f6e2957651b638374b6eb4c0a3.gif

Certain objects now display interaction animations when used.
For example, when a guest sits under a shower, water flows out.
If they step onto a scale, they might react with joy—or sadness if their weight has unexpectedly increased.
We plan to gradually expand this feature to more objects in future updates.



New Facilities: Floor Planning Desk & Statistics Desk

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/301d4480b8e7aa24e45af922564d25d27bf648b0.png


 Floor Planning Desk: Allows you to set how much guest traffic is guided to each floor to support different floor management strategies.
 Statistics Desk: Provides a comprehensive view of your bathhouse’s sales and guest preferences.


New Feature: Hide UI

When no input is detected for a while, the UI will smoothly hide itself.
It will reappear when you start interacting again.


New Setting: Frame Rate Limit

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/ec69fb09ec69d1d9f0a8cbb39ebfc3d755743ed9.png

You can now sync the frame rate to your monitor’s refresh rate using vertical sync,
or manually limit the frame rate to 30, 60, 120, or 144 FPS to optimize performance based on your device.


New Setting: Overload Protection

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/2e8e78c7edde73560ad120648952c88d50fe9464.png

To prevent potential freezes due to overload when idle for long periods,
the game will now automatically save and return to the main menu after a set amount of inactivity.
This functions similarly to temporary closing—guests will leave and gradually return.
You can disable this feature or adjust the idle time threshold in the settings.


-------------------------------------------


Coming Soon

In Development: Furniture Rotation

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/9297fbfd8a6428bd13719b1fb04e3e50cccbc56f.png

We are developing the long-awaited furniture rotation feature.
We are starting with objects that are 2 or more tiles wide, allowing players to decorate more freely and conveniently.

In Development: Cross-Stage Features & Customization

Many players have reported that moving to a new stage feels disconnected since progress doesn’t carry over.
To address this, we are planning and developing cross-stage features as follows:


 Staff Dispatch: Temporarily hire staff from other stages for a set period.
 Stage-Specific Letters: Receive themed stories matching each stage’s setting.
 Stage-Specific Challenges: Experience new obstacles themed around each stage that make operations more challenging.
 Point Collection from Other Bathhouses: Earn points based on progress in other save files, which can be used to customize Maltese and Retriever characters.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/3855d5bb65508a4daba84abc21921ba460b6cd1a.png

notes.title: [Patch Note] v1.02
notes.notes:
New Features

 Save Backup
A backup system has been added to protect against unexpected shutdowns.
If your save data is corrupted or missing when launching the game, the latest backup will automatically be restored as your save file.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/2f9eb4a2a90a03e38f716d3dc24b9ede95578f42.png
 Added a toggle to stop receiving new job applications.
 The number of staff currently working in each facility is now displayed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/369098a6478e44e3395468697b8aed87220937c6.png
 Staff list can now be sorted by hire date, animal type, or upgrade level.
 Added a notice that regular staff can be upgraded via the Staff Training Room.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/7ff2ae2d752a04e3283b1217807258bcd6cad561.png
 You can now obtain stars by reading guest conversations.

 Guests will now step onto the scale.
 The total amount earned from selling items is now displayed.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where Twitch/stream viewers were not reset when returning to the main menu.
 Fixed an issue where fired staff would remain in the bathhouse.
 Improved excessive CPU usage.
We plan to add spec-related options in future updates to ensure better optimization across various devices.

notes.title: [Patch Note] v1.01b
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where text above guest characters appeared broken when Douyu viewers joined.
 Fixed an issue where empty spaces created by left/right offset could not be clicked for interaction.
 Fixed an issue where the track title did not update when holding the jukebox while listening to music.
 Fixed an issue where marketing costs were still charged during temporary closure.


Visual Fixes

 Fixed a layering issue where the outdoor door in Sun City appeared above the characters.


Text Corrections

 Fixed incorrect stage names in character unlock requirements.
 Fixed an issue where bathhouse names in Chinese characters broke in the medal display UI.
 Improved the description for the restock upgrade. (This upgrade activates when stock reaches 10%.)


UI

 Added a version watermark on the gameplay screen to make it easier to check the version when reporting bugs.

notes.title: [Patch Note] v1.01
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! ːsteamhappyː
Thank you so much for all the love and support since our launch.
Here are the feature improvements and bug fixes we implemented in yesterday’s update.

Feature Improvements

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/b8ff6cf8774aa4cfb55c92ff3201f59e128b4e9d.png
 Improved the UI for guest unlock conditions.
 Added color variations to indicate normal, special, and unique guest types in the unlock condition text.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/f8da220eceebe6774e0a3e526801fe9a92100412.png

notes.title: Full Release Date!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Many of you have been waiting for this news —
the official release date for Animal Spa has been decided!

[previewyoutube=GgqAOMWL22A;full][/previewyoutube]

Animal Spa is officially launching on May 14!

The price will be set at $5.99 USD, and to celebrate the launch, we will be offering a 10% discount for the first two weeks. We hope you’re looking forward to it!

If you’ve played the demo or followed our Steam announcements, you may already be familiar with some updates.
But here’s a full overview of what’s changing with the official release!


What’s New in the Full Release?

1. 8 Additional Stages

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/7bd77d903806626ea33dd5a6a4da1b9092836557.png

You may have already visited Cherry Blossom City and Bamboo Garden through the recent demo update.
In the full release, eight new stages will be available in addition to the default ones!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/7b213676102380b5aa2f42c7ff6c281e5f68bada.png

By running your bathhouse and earning medals, you can obtain keys to unlock new stages.
Use the keys to open bathhouses in the areas you choose!



2. Staff Management

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/1823c2e75e6752bf2e74096721db5bf6efd33579.png

Through the Staff Training Room, you can upgrade various staff features that players have requested.
Expand the number of job applications and employees, enable staff to pre-stock supplies, and improve other staff management functions!

3. Time System

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/68aa1a1f6bc7b5501d723fa7e9d469d434c3d1e0.png

You can now synchronize the outdoor time in your bathhouse with your computer’s system clock and experience four different times of day.
Time changes are purely visual and won’t affect gameplay.
You can adjust the time freely using the Time Desk!



4. More Characters and Items

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/12a90c49b68bce3eaf23c981b0c2212831c70bed.png

Unlock new stages to meet new characters and discover new decor items!
There are also hidden characters that can be unlocked by fulfilling special conditions — see if you can uncover all the secrets!



5. Collect All the Letters

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/9e747388d90e67384fcfac1bd9a3019c44e168a4.png

In the full version, you can collect all 48 letters sent by the animal guests.
By using decorations that the guests love, you’ll receive letters from them.
Enjoy their heartfelt stories and unlock new OST tracks to play in the jukebox!

(We are also planning to add special illustrations for each letter in a future update — please look forward to it!)





We sincerely thank everyone who played the demo and provided feedback and bug reports over the past three months since February 18.

Even after the official launch, we have many exciting updates planned!
If you haven’t already, please add Animal Spa to your wishlist to stay updated!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3404470/_/

Thank you!

notes.title: [Update] Demo v0.5
notes.notes:

System Additions  
1. Guest Conversations  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/5a44f022280efc2fef7d06799d3646e76a9a0c0e.png  

Guests in the bathhouse will occasionally stop and share their thoughts about the bathhouse.  
Currently, they only exchange casual chatter, but in future updates, we plan to have them share tips that help with bathhouse management!

2. Default Guest Info  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/1f019a4aab081e9b38173b343ec1f27d825ab9be.png  

Animal Spa assigns 4 random default guests out of a total of 8 to your Steam account.  
Later on, you can obtain the guests you're missing by earning platinum medals in each category or by connecting with friends via the Exchange Computer.

However, since the concept of "default guests" wasn’t clearly communicated in-game,  
you’ll now be informed which default guests have been assigned to your account when starting the game.

This information can also be viewed when you interact with the Exchange Computer.

3. New Letter Related to Keys  
When you collect a certain number of medals, you will receive a letter that explains how to unlock the next stage.

Resolution  
  
 On Mac, the game now automatically adjusts the offset to match the Dock size when launched for the first time.  


Convenience Improvements  
  
 UI buttons will no longer be clickable while placing objects.  


Bug Fixes  
  
 Fixed an issue where some staff had no working animation.  
 After placing an object, its occupied area will now be immediately displayed.  
 Fixed an issue where some letter rewards were not clickable.

notes.title: [Update] Demo v0.4
notes.notes:
Hello!

Since the last demo update at the end of last month, many newly developed features have been added to the demo version as well.

Please check out the update details below!

Hiring and Managing Staff

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/2a4d74c8828dd91d70d3942cf9c656ee592be4e6.jpg

You can now hire and upgrade staff members.
When animals use facilities they like, they may send you a job application.
You can review the applications and decide whether to hire or decline them.

There are 24 basic animals in total, with 3 types for each of the 8 categories. These basic animals cannot be upgraded.
However, unique characters like Maltese, Retriever, and other special characters obtained through certain conditions can be upgraded.

In the demo version, you can hire up to 10 staff members.
In the full version, you will be able to hire many more.

Interacting with Friends

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/1b6fe000f63266136b4f66f2896883c72ce47537.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/47c7fd87c88d713e0e975bab5778987f5c881ae4.jpg

You can interact with friends who are also playing Animal Spa.
You may unlock basic animals that your friend has but you don’t, or receive stars instead.

You can check the detailed usage in-game by pressing the ? button.

Stages

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/c527c39d708426c8797cf20e817c140b3d1140c3.jpg

In the updated demo version, you can now unlock and play the “Cherry Blossom City” and “Bamboo Garden” stages.
Stages can be unlocked using keys obtained by collecting 24 medals in each stage.

Once a stage is unlocked, new characters, BGM, and decorative items become available.

Letters & BGM

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/846fe6d6e0ee36007cf92e62603329f0ae473732.png

Guests will send you letters when they enjoy using their favorite facilities.
In the full version, each animal will have 6 letters, totaling 48 unique letters.
Unlocking letters will also reward you with new BGM tracks.

In the demo version, only 1 letter per animal can be unlocked.

Operational Facilities
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/767be3ee5d5f66b43bad37540ffef27dee6a5be5.png

Several new operational facilities have been added to support more efficient bathhouse management.
You can assign hired staff or set budgets to optimize your operations.

If you encounter any bugs or have feedback while playing the newly updated demo version, please share them in the Steam community forums or on our Discord.

We will continue working to deliver a more polished full release.

Thank you!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Review and Release Roadmap
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/9371e99b6c70d955c7c581ac58c571f172fd3ea8.png 

Hello everyone!  

The one-week-long Steam Next Fest has come to an end.  
And since the demo was first released, it has been downloaded 75,000 times!  

Additionally, our game ranked 25th among the most-played demos in the February edition of Steam Next Fest!  
https://store.steampowered.com/sale/nextfestmostplayed_feb_2025  

We sincerely appreciate your incredible support and interest in our game.  
We are aiming for an official release in May, with the exact release date to be announced at the end of March.  

We will do our best to incorporate all bug reports and suggestions from the demo into the full version.  

Here’s a sneak peek at the features coming in the full release:  

---

1. More Characters  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/41836ea00517aa1cd92b6e798cc9800ca5a91d48.png  

As seen in the demo, when you start the game, you will have four out of eight different types of animal guests available.  
To unlock guests you don’t have, you can interact with friends through the computer object  
or complete specific achievements assigned to each guest.  

Since the demo version does not allow the use of the computer object and some achievements are currently unavailable,  
you can look forward to meeting a wider variety of guests in the full release!  

---

2. Stages  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/7bd77d903806626ea33dd5a6a4da1b9092836557.png  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/bd91b219706863165f39951498df07a4764dcfb2.png  

The full release will include eight additional stages along with the default stage.  
Unlocking these stages will also grant access to new characters, objects, and background music.  
We will reveal the unlock conditions for each stage soon!  

---

3. Staff Hiring & Management  

As we’ve mentioned in the community, the full version will introduce a staff hiring and upgrade system.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/fd8a3b7a1001906563df87a84a3cf045838599fe.png  

There will also be special facilities that require staff to operate.  
For example, employees can go outside to hand out flyers or sell bath products,  
greatly helping with bathhouse management.  
We hope you're excited for this feature!  

---

4. Letters from Guests  

Satisfied guests will send thank-you letters to express their gratitude.  
These letters will share their stories of how your bathhouse helped them relax and recover.  

---

5. Jukebox  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403507/12ba29f6f0a47e8b7772c7574a71fd476a44d7c9.png  

Unlocking new stages and receiving guest letters will allow you to collect new background music.  
You can add or remove these songs from your playlist using the jukebox!  

---

6. More Facilities  

Of course, even more furniture and facilities will be added!  
From decorations to bathhouse utilities and convenience items,  
you will discover many new additions in the full release.  

---

Your messages of support mean the world to us!  
If you have any feedback or suggestions, please share them through the Steam Community or Discord channel.  
Your input helps us refine the game for an even better full release.  

Thank you!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest & Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hello! ːoguHeartː

"Animal Spa" is participating in Steam Next Fest, which will run for one week starting on the 25th at 3 AM KST! 
Enjoy Animal Spa, set to be released within the first half of the year, and please share your thoughts and feedback on the Steam Community or our Discord channel!  

If you haven't seen the demo trailer yet, check it out below!  

[previewyoutube=0M-PRuE6TYk;full][/previewyoutube]  

Additionally, based on feedback and bug reports collected over the weekend, Demo Version 0.21 has been updated.  

System  
  
 When placing or moving items, the placement areas of already installed items will now be displayed.  
  

Content  
  
 A total of six new floor and wall interior items have been added to the demo version.  
  

Bug Fixes  
  
 Some guests will now travel to distant facilities.  
 Guests will no longer move into inaccessible areas when getting off chairs.  
 Fixed an issue where items placed on shelves sometimes had incorrect layering.  
 Fixed an issue where removing items and getting a refund would incorrectly count toward the "earning money" achievement.  
  

Visual Effects  
  
 Fixed an issue where steam from baths on other floors was visible.  
 Fixed an issue where heart effects appeared in empty spaces.  
  

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------  

Frequently Asked Questions  

Q: How do I hire staff? And how can I interact with friends?
A: The staff hiring and management system, as well as friend interactions, are not available in the demo version.  
These features will be available in the full release!  

Q: Where can I use stars?
A: Stars will primarily be used for hiring and managing staff after the full release.  

Q: Will demo save data be carried over to the full release?
A: Yes! Your save data from the demo will carry over to the full version.
However, if any unexpected issues arise that prevent data transfer, we will notify you in advance!  

Q: When is the full release date?
A: The exact date is not yet decided, but the game is planned to launch within the first half of this year. 

Q: Will there be a Mac version?
A: It is currently in development!

---  

Your support and enthusiasm mean the world to us!  

Thank you! 🎉
